question: Agar is obtained from:
solution:
The correct answer is, '**red algae**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Agar** is also known as **Agar Agar**. It's a jelly-like substance having polysaccharides from the cell wall of red algae.

 
 
• It is used as an** ingredient in desserts, a good substitute for gelatin, an appetite suppressant, and many more**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Green-blue algae** are used as** a supplement of protein, for high blood pressure, high cholesterol, obesity, and many other conditions**.
 
• **Green algae** have unique properties and are used in many areas and many forms such as **anti-bacterial, anti-viral, antioxidants**, etc.
 
• **Brown algae** are used to make **liquid products thicker and cream-like. **
